SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.question, r.answer_text, r.refused, r.refusal_reason, r.top_relevance, r.rating, r.feedback_comment, r.created_at, r.rewritten_question, r.review_status, r.resolution_note, r.resolved_at, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT c.document_name, chr(31)) FROM answer_citation c WHERE c.answer_id = r.id) AS cited_documents FROM answer_record r
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) AS questions, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS askers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE refused) AS refused, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refused AND rating IS NOT NULL) AS rated, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refused AND rating = 'UP') AS liked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refused AND rating = 'DOWN') AS disliked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'OPEN' AND (refused OR rating = 'DOWN')) AS open_reviews, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer_citation c WHERE c.answer_id = answer_record.id)) AS cited_answers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer_citation_open o WHERE o.answer_id = answer_record.id)) AS opened_answers FROM answer_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}

SELECT cur.id AS record_id, prev.question_embedding AS previous_vector, cur.question_embedding AS current_vector FROM answer_record cur JOIN answer_record prev ON prev.tenant_id = cur.tenant_id AND prev.user_id = cur.user_id AND prev.created_at < cur.created_at AND prev.created_at >= cur.created_at - make_interval(secs => #{seconds}) WHERE cur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cur.created_at >= #{from} AND cur.created_at < #{to} AND cur.question_embedding IS NOT NULL AND prev.question_embedding IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE #{zone} AS date) AS day, count(*) AS questions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE refused) AS refused, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refused AND rating = 'DOWN') AS disliked FROM answer_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY day

SELECT refusal_reason AS label, count(*) AS count FROM answer_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND refused GROUP BY refusal_reason ORDER BY count DESC, refusal_reason

SELECT c.document_name AS label, count(DISTINCT c.answer_id) AS count FROM answer_citation c JOIN answer_record r ON r.id = c.answer_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY c.document_name ORDER BY count DESC, c.document_name LIMIT #{limit}
